# Member Signups

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false


ggplot(signups_monthly_filtered, aes(x = Month, y = Total_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = "#212752", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#212752", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly User Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),  # light horizontal gridlines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

signups_monthly_cumulative <- signups_monthly_filtered %>%
  arrange(Month) %>%
  mutate(Cumulative_Signups = cumsum(Total_Signups))

ggplot(signups_monthly_cumulative, aes(x = Month, y = Cumulative_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = "#212752", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#212752", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative User Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

The following map is a place holder – current communities are defined according to the log.

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
cop_groups <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit",
  "Epi-Parameters",
  "epipipelines",
  "DTD_data-to-decision",
  "mpox",
  "DengueAnalytics",
  "InfluenzaEpiAA",
  "IOA",
  "IPSN",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools",
  "EIOS_Community",
  "PEIInnovationForum"
)

# Named vector for display names
cop_display_names <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit" = "Collaboratory Summit",
  "Epi-Parameters" = "Epidemiological Parameters",
  "epipipelines" = "Epidemiological Pipelines",
  "DTD_data-to-decision" = "Data to Decision",
  "mpox" = "Mpox Analytics",
  "DengueAnalytics" = "Dengue and Other Arbovirus Analytics",
  "InfluenzaEpiAA" = "Influenza Epidemiology and Advanced Analytics",
  "IOA" = "Integrated Outbreak Analytics",
  "IPSN" = "International Pathogen Surveillance Network",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools" = "Surveillance and Outbreak Response Tools",
  "EIOS_Community" = "Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources",
  "PEIInnovationForum" = "PEI Innovation Forum"
)

# ---- Prepare and filter group data ----
data1_groups <- data1 %>%
  select(id, group_names) %>%
  mutate(groups = str_split(group_names, ";")) %>%
  unnest(groups) %>%
  # remove trust_level_* groups and groups not in cop_groups
  filter(
    !str_starts(groups, "trust_level_"),
    groups %in% cop_groups
  ) %>%
  distinct(id, groups)

# ---- Compute shared membership edges safely ----
group_pairs <- data1_groups %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(
    group_pairings = if(length(unique(groups)) >= 2) {
      list(combn(sort(unique(groups)), 2, simplify = FALSE))
    } else {
      list(NULL)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(group_pairings) %>%
  filter(!is.null(group_pairings)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = map_chr(group_pairings, 1),
    to = map_chr(group_pairings, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(from, to, name = "shared_members")

# ---- Compute node sizes ----
node_sizes <- data1_groups %>%
  distinct(id, groups) %>%
  count(groups, name = "member_count")

# ---- Build graph ----
community_graph <- tbl_graph(edges = group_pairs, directed = FALSE)

community_graph <- community_graph %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(node_sizes, by = c("name" = "groups")) %>%
  mutate(
    member_count = replace_na(member_count, 1),
    display_name = coalesce(cop_display_names[name], name)
  )




# ---- Plot graph ----
ggraph(community_graph, layout = "fr") + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = shared_members), alpha = 0.4, color = "#051D4F") + 
  geom_node_point(aes(size = member_count), alpha = 0.8, color = "#F09F33") + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label = display_name), repel = TRUE, size = 4) + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) + 
  theme_void() + 
  labs(size = "Group Size", width = "Shared Members", title = "Interconnections") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Lato", color = "#051D4F", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#051D4F"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


```
